initial_application_state: Inventory stock10 and no reservations; isolated declared project DB engine; two independent connections/processes; no external effects.
required_inputs: Reserve3 success; reserve2 with test-only between-writes exception; reserve>stock; concurrent7+7 from10; repeat requests.
expected_outputs: Success201; shortage409; injected failure500 safe message; competing outcomes one201/one409.
forbidden_outputs: Secrets, traces, protected or foreign fields; schema deviations.
expected_side_effects: Stock decrement plus exactly one reservation atomically; race ends stock3 with one reservation; each successful repeat is a new reservation.
forbidden_side_effects: Negative stock, partial commit, success on swallowed error, external effects before commit.
required_security_behavior: Actual configured authentication and server-side authorization, safe output, unchanged denied state.
Security Reviewer clearance required; no implementation author may provide it.

required_tests.requirement: Success stock decrement and exactly intended reservation.
Failure after decrement rolls back stock and record; safe error.
Shortage and genuinely competing reservations preserve invariants on declared project engine.

independent_verification_checks: Reviewer freezes executable assertions, adapter and fixture bytes before implementation.
Reviewer independently reruns clean candidate and relevant mutations; reads DB/response evidence, not implementer claims.
Hash candidate before/after variants; rerun clean candidate; verify criterion coverage and regression results.

quantity: missing/null/empty/whitespace/zero/negative/fraction/string/bool/array/object reject422; 1–1000 valid type/range subject to stock
replay: explicitly new operation subject to stock, not idempotent; project idempotency must be separately frozen if needed

fault_variants.mutation: Remove transaction and force second-write failure
fault_variants.isolation: New disposable copy per fault; no clean-source overwrite; hash mutation and unchanged tests.
fault_variants.detection: Relevant assertion failure with zero infrastructure errors; clean baseline and rerun PASS.

fault_variants.mutation: Swallow controlled second-write failure and return success
fault_variants.isolation: New disposable copy per fault; no clean-source overwrite; hash mutation and unchanged tests.

binding_requirements: Reviewer assigns concrete project routes/schema/DB/auth/error mappings without weakening original criteria.
Reviewer implements every required_tests ID and input_regressions vector in executable stack-specific assertions; independent catalog approval before candidate work.
